anita_cs: MavenAI dedicated bring-up next Wed. Need quota, autoscale SLOs, and a short load-test plan. Renewal in 5w — want smooth first 48h. Who takes quota?
joel_ops: I'll do quota. what's baseline + bursts?
anita_cs: baseline ~70 qps, bursts to 380 qps for 3-6m. Embedding batch at 02:00 UTC ~1.8k rps for 8m. Gen avg 700 tokens, tails to 2.5k.
sam_eng: Recommend 8 GPUs base, burst +4. Autoscale: scale-up if 95p latency > 320ms for 45s; scale-down cooldown 6m. Canary: 2 GPUs at 10% traffic for 15m. Fallback to quantized variant on error spike.
rachel_sre: Load test plan: (1) 18h shadow to seed KV; (2) embedding blast 10m@2k rps; (3) gen stepped soak 5m rungs: 75/250/400 concurrent. Monitor 99/95/50p, GPU util, error-rate. I'll book oncall Wed 13:00-17:00.
ben_fin: finance wants cost per 100M tokens w/ and w/o caching. Need quota draft by Tue EOD.
opsbot: shadow-job/maven-seed-3112 created (ETA 4h).
anita_cs: action items: @joel_ops quota by Tue EOD, @sam_eng canary PR, @rachel_sre oncall + run shadow, @ben_fin cost appendix. I'll update customer after quota sign-off.
